description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractJmsListener that implements message listening and exception handling for JMS messages within the OFBiz framework. It manages service invocation based on received JMS MapMessages, deserializes message content, and handles connection re-establishment.

classes.name: AbstractJmsListener
